Hi Jordan / Redwood team,

Were preparing the on-prem VPC deployment cutover next month and want to align on the control-plane identity handoff. Alice thanks for the note and the metadata. High-level plan below 

Proposed timeline:
- Staging canary (control plane in Acme VPC, limited operators): 2026-07-01
- Post-canary validation window: 3 days (2026-07-02 to 2026-07-04)
- Full cutover (all operator flows): 2026-07-08

Pre-cutover deliverables (Acme):
- Signed cutover approval (change window)
- SAML IdP metadata + contact for cert rotation
- SCIM base URL and service account credentials (scoped)
- Allowlist of Redwood egress CIDRs for the control-plane endpoints

Pre-cutover deliverables (Redwood):
- Runbook + rollback playbook (we will provide test accounts and a step-by-step validation checklist)
- SCIM attribute/field mapping we will implement (proposed below)
- Audit log export configuration and retention options

Operator role guidance (initial):
- redwood:admin (full admin, restricted to named operator principals)
- redwood:operator (deployments, restart, rollbacks)
- redwood:observer (read-only, troubleshooting)

Ben and Mina will own the technical checklist and the SOC/audit items; Naomi will coordinate the change approval.

Adding a compact technical checklist 

SAML requirements (minimum):
- Assertion attributes: email, given_name, family_name, groups (preferably in RFC 7642 group format)
- NameID: email or persistent identifier; format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
- Assertion signature + IdP metadata exchange (we have to verify cert thumbprint)

SCIM provisioning contract (proposed):
- Endpoints: /scim/v2/Users, /scim/v2/Groups
- Auth: scoped service account bearer token (rotating monthly or per-cutover)
- Required attributes we will write: userName (email), active, displayName, externalId, groups[]
- Group->role mapping (SCIM group.name -> role):
  - acme-redwood-admins -> redwood:admin
  - acme-redwood-operators -> redwood:operator
  - acme-redwood-readonly -> redwood:observer

Network / connectivity:
- Redwood control-plane egress: allowlist 52.210.33.0/24, 18.197.64.0/22 (sample, final list to be provided by infra)
- Healthcheck ports: 443 (SAML), 8443 (SCIM test endpoint)

Fallback / break-glass:
- We require a secondary emergency access path (time-limited service account + IP-restricted key) documented in the runbook.

Attachments: priv-deploy-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook draft)

Quick note on audit/logging:
- SOC2 teams typically require 365-day retention for control-plane audit events; for on-prem customers we offer two options:
  1) Redwood-managed export: ship compressed, redacted audit batches to a customer S3 (KMS-encrypted) daily.
  2) Customer pull: customer queries logs via secure API (shorter retention on Redwood side).

We need to confirm Acme's retention requirement and whether they will provide an S3 bucket + KMS key policy allowing Redwood to write. If Acme wants >365 days, well need a special retention addendum (legal).

Also: please confirm whether operator principals need MFA assertions in the SAML response (we can require a 'acr' claim).
